name: esf-thunderbird

scripts.whitepaper: node tools/render-whitepaper.mjs && node tools/render-whitepaper-odt.mjs && node tools/render-whitepaper-docx.mjs && node tools/check-whitepaper.mjs
scripts.roadmap: node tools/render-whitepaper.mjs --name ESF_End_Spam_Forever_Adoption_Roadmap && node tools/render-whitepaper-odt.mjs --name ESF_End_Spam_Forever_Adoption_Roadmap && node tools/render-whitepaper-docx.mjs --name ESF_End_Spam_Forever_Adoption_Roadmap
scripts.docs: npm run whitepaper && npm run roadmap
